item.title: 💬 'Even greeting were forbidden': why the command of the AFU warns against communicating with residents of Kramatorsk
item.description: 'Even greeting were forbidden': why the command of the AFU warns against communicating with residents of Kramatorsk 💬 According to POW Vitaly Mosin, the AFU command prohibited soldiers from making any contact with the people of Kramatorsk because of their extremely hostile attitude towards the Ukrainian army. They attributed this to the fact that beneath the surface politeness of the local residents hides a profound hatred toward the AFU, along with a willingness to resort to radical measures. 'We got to Kramatorsk. A company CO warned us not to communicate the locals, enter their houses, greet them at all. Like, you'll talk to him, he'll smile in your face. You turn away, he'll stab you in the back. So, we were not allowed to you even to say hello to them.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29808

'Even greeting were forbidden': why the command of the AFU warns against communicating with residents of Kramatorsk
💬
According to POW Vitaly Mosin, the
AFU command prohibited soldiers from making any contact with the people of Kramatorsk because of their extremely hostile attitude towards the Ukrainian army.
They attributed this to the fact that beneath the surface politeness of the local residents hides a profound hatred toward the AFU, along with a willingness to resort to radical measures.
'We got to Kramatorsk. A company CO warned us not to communicate the locals, enter their houses, greet them at all. Like, you'll talk to him, he'll smile in your face. You turn away, he'll stab you in the back. So, we were not allowed to you even to say hello to them.'
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🔥 It is loud in Yurginsky: another phase of the Centre 2026 strategic command post exercise
item.description: 🔥 It is loud in Yurginsky: another phase of the Centre 2026 strategic command post exercise 📍 Kemerovo region 👉 Units set a tactical trap for the mock enemy. First, they lured him into a kill zone and then engaged him by formidable fire. 🤖 Drones coordinated artillery fire, assault detachments on motorbikes flew to the positions across the passages, which were cleared for them by the Bogomol UGV. The servicemen promptly mined the escape route of the enemy with the help of the Lyagushka UGV. #Centre2026 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⚡️ Dazzling strike on enemy Molniya-2 fixed-wing UAVs from the 20th Guards Combined Arms Army (Zapad Group of Forces)
item.description: ⚡️ ️️ Dazzling strike on enemy 🎮 Molniya-2 fixed-wing UAVs from the 20th Guards Combined Arms Army (Zapad Group of Forces) hit AFU materiel and manpower near the eastern bank of the Oskol Reservoir in the Donetsk People’s Republic. 💬 The commander of a UAV squad with the call sign 'Brat' said that even in a heavy fog, when visibility is low, the servicemen pilot their drones and accurately hit targets. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
